title: Static Split Half Door and Frame
description: One newly authored complete static horizontally split village door assembly. A full U-shaped timber frame surrounds a closed lower leaf and a separately outward-resting upper leaf, each with two distinct fixed vertical hinge stations, full straps and a pull. The upper half is held at58degrees while the lower half remains across the doorway, leaving an actual upper entry aperture and a full lower boundary. These are newly authored separate upper/lower whole leaves, not a recolored single full-height door, a second side-by-side door or copied old moving parts. All components are closed editable solids and three constant opaque PBR materials; native metres and bounds-centred ground datum. One modular model, zero scenes. Only the illustrated fixed pose is provided; no animation, continuous sweep, hinge physics, compatible old host, actual animal/child containment, lock security, manufacture, load or safety guarantee. No building or scenery; preview floor excluded.
